agreement: does a graph split across owners answer like one held whole -- the question testbed/driver.py left behind, asked of the count graph. Its caller is the container driver, which is a later phase: two processes on a socket is a different question (latency, departure, partition) and this one has to hold first. Exercised in-process by tests/test_agreement.py, which is where the C1 result currently lives.
broadcast: the broadcast flood: many seeds, stamina in place of a floor, and termination by accounting. Built 2026-08-01 and callerless on purpose for one step. Its caller is the experiment that measures whether many simultaneous seeds supply the discrimination that edge kinds supplied on a typed graph — and that experiment cannot answer its own question until the word channel stops being one node per class, which is the next job and is named in NOW.md. Exercised by tests/test_broadcast.py and four mutations, all caught.
bucket_peer: the peer that answers reads over a socket. Nothing runs a node -- node_main.py was deliberately not carried over in the restructure -- so the whole distributed half has tests and no caller.
deployment: decides how many slices a machine can hold. Reads a cgroup and plans for a node nobody starts.
federated: the count graph split across owners, with the remote reads counted. Same missing entry point.
node_main: the entry point for ONE node, launched as a process rather than imported: python -m openplexus.node_main. Callerless on purpose until testbed/driver.py is rewritten against bucket_peer, which is the next job. Smoke-tested end to end: a real process listening on TCP answered a real socket request.
shared: one CoOccurrence holding several kinds, through one Namespace. The thing this project never had. Tests demonstrate a route crossing from a picture to a fact through a word, between kinds that never co-occurred. Its caller is the merged pipeline, which is the next piece and is named in NOW.md.
tasks.asking: a world that can be ASKED rather than only watched. Its falsifier was registered as g44-01 and never run, so the task exists and the experiment that would use it does not.
tasks.snake: a world that answers back: snake with a local, head-centred view. Built 2026-08-01 as the step before ARC-AGI-3, and callerless until the prediction experiment exists -- predicting the next view from the current view AND the action is a TRIPLE, so its caller is a Composition, not a CoOccurrence. Exercised by tests/test_snake.py and two mutations, both caught.
tasks.xsl: cross-situational word learning, read from external trials. No sweep currently reads it.
